application.name: Point Cloud to Depth
application.description: Projects point clouds into a pinhole camera on the GPU with holoscan-point-cloud's PointCloudToDepthOp, making z-buffered depth images (float32 meters or uint16) and color images, from synthetic clouds checked pixel by pixel against ground truth, or from a folder of PLY files, and can write the images as PGM and PPM files.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-point-cloud demo of PointCloudToDepthOp, with synthetic and PLY point cloud sources, a ground-truth reporter and PGM and PPM output.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Project 300 synthetic point clouds with colors, checking every depth and color pixel against ground truth.

files.description: Project the binary little-endian PLY files in the data directory. Pass the image size and the camera's intrinsics with --run-args.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic clouds in a body frame with colors and per-frame intrinsics, projected to uint16 depth, every pixel checked against ground truth.
